name: REPORT_REQUIREMENTS_SCHEMA
description: Defines which reports are hard gate vs advisory for audit bundle closure.

reports.name: PHASE_*_FINAL_REPORT.md
reports.notes: Human-readable phase summary. Advisory in content; hard gate because it must exist.

reports.name: reports/audit-bundle-schema-validation-report.json
reports.notes: Schema compliance check. Must exist with verdict PASS.

reports.name: reports/bundle-layout-report.json
reports.notes: Layout validation report from validate-bundle-layout.ps1. Must be PASS.

reports.name: reports/sha256sums-validation-report.json
reports.notes: SHA256SUMS validation report. Must have 0 mismatches.

reports.name: run/validate-state-stdout.log
reports.notes: stdout from validate-state.ps1. Must show run_passed verdict.

reportIntegrityRules: Final report must not claim untested capabilities
Final report must not contain ZIP self-SHA256
Final report must distinguish ENGINEERING_PASS from AUDIT_PASS
Final report must list ZIP absolute path for external audit
